The ReflectionHLE launcher lists the exact supported versions and required files. Select the real original folder there; its executable is original input, not the Windows player to register. Reuse a recognized installed copy without moving your originals. Extract the official Windows 64-bit ZIP and keep reflectionhle.exe, SDL3.dll and libspeexdsp-1.dll together. Select reflectionhle.exe inside its wrapper folder and use that same folder as the working directory. Leave launch arguments empty to use the game/version picker. Complete original-file selection in the upstream launcher after explicit Play. Registration does not start it; Portcove discovery runs no original EXE, helper or game. Windows normally stores ReflectionHLE settings and per-version writable data beneath %APPDATA%/reflectionhle. Preserve that whole profile, your original game folders and any custom data/config/mod locations with all copies closed before changing runtimes. Several game entries share settings; version-specific writable folders remain distinct. Changing a data/config argument redirects storage and does not migrate it. Retain the working runtime for existing saves; no cross-version or cross-engine save compatibility is established. You and upstream maintain this external player, original files and profile. Portcove offers explicit registration, supervised Play and registration-only removal; it does not acquire ownership of the external files or offer managed Update, Backup, Rollback or deletion. Keep a working copy and back up its actual data before an upstream update. Other platforms need their own supported upstream package/application flow; this Windows guide does not establish native execution on any platform.
